slides.title: Cabin filter variants
paragraphs: Particulate filters provide essential filtration for vehicle cabins, helping capture PM10-sized particles, dust, and pollen from incoming air. Designed to withstand moisture and temperature variations, they offer a durable and reliable filtration solution for cars and other vehicles
Carbon active filters provide advanced protection for vehicle cabin by combining particle filtration with odor and harmful-gas removal.
Our carbon active air filters adsorbs pollutants such as SO₂, nitrogen oxides, and hydrocarbons, helping deliver cleaner and fresher air inside the vehicles.

Bio-functional Filters provide enhanced protection by combining particle filtration, gas and Odor adsorption, and allergen control. The activated carbon layer helps capture harmful gases and unpleasant Odors, while specialized filtration media helps bind allergens.

High-performance filters are designed to capture ultra-fine particles and provide an enhanced level of air purification. Our HEPA H14 filters achieve a filtration efficiency of more than 99.995%, helping remove viruses, bacteria, pollen, allergens, and fine dust from the air.
Fine dust PM 2.5 filters combines a durable carrier layer with ultra-fine polymer fibers, delivering high particle separation efficiency.
The advanced fiber structure is particularly effective in capturing fine and ultra-fine particles, helping provide consistent filtration performance and cleaner cabin air.

slides.title: Nonwoven filtration media
paragraphs: “ Advanced Nonwoven Media for High-Performance Filtration”
At PARK Nonwoven filtration media are heart of every high-performance filtration solution.
We develop and manufacture advanced nonwoven filtration materials engineered to deliver the right balance of performance, durability, and energy efficiency across various filtration applications.
Our filtration media are designed around three critical performance parameters:
Filtration Efficiency: Effective capture of dust, particles, allergens, and other contaminants to support cleaner air and protect people, processes, and equipment.
Low Pressure Drop: Optimized media structure provides low airflow resistance, helping reduce energy consumption while maintaining efficient filtration performance.
Dust-Holding Capacity: High contaminant retention enables longer filter service life, consistent performance, and reduced maintenance frequency.
